description: Header file declaring command-line utility functions for various git-related tools, including function prototypes for commands like advise_if_enabled, bitmap, bloom, bundle_uri, cache_tree, chmtime, config, crontab, csprng, date, delta, delete_gpgsig, dir_iterator, drop_caches, dump_cache_tree, dump_fsmonitor, dump_split_index, dump_untracked_cache, dump_reftable, env_helper, example_tap, find_pack, fsmonitor_client, genrandom, genzeros, getcwd, hashmap, hash_speed, hexdump, json_writer, lazy_init_name_hash, match_trees, mergesort, mktemp, name_hash, online_cpus, pack_deltas, pack_mtimes, parse_options, parse_options_flags, parse_pathspec_file, parse_subcommand, partial_clone, path_utils, path_walk, pcre2_config, pkt_line, proc_receive, progress, reach, read_cache, read_graph, read_midx, ref_store, rot13_filter, regex, repository, revision_walking, run_command, scrap_cache_tree, serve_v2, sha1, sha1_is_sha1dc, sha1_unsafe, sha256, sigchain, simple_ipc, string_list, submodule, submodule_config, submodule_nested_repo_config, subprocess, trace2, truncate, userdiff, xml_encode, wildmatch, windows_named_pipe, write_cache, zlib, and a helper function cmd_hash_impl.
